label: Previous-day high
gloss: the previous UTC day’s high — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

label: Previous-day low
gloss: the previous UTC day’s low — the literal prior-day extreme, not a tracked swing pivot

label: Previous-day open
gloss: the previous UTC day’s opening print — the literal prior-day open, not a tracked swing pivot

label: Day high so far
gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day so far — a point-in-time read at its own fold

label: Day low so far
gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day so far — a point-in-time read at its own fold

label: Supply zone edge (prior UTC day)
gloss: the zone's inner edge — that bin's bound farther from the high, on the supply zone of the previous completed UTC day: its range cut into 50 equal bins counted from the window high, each holding the volume of the 1m bars whose high lies in it, and the zone runs from the high to the first bin whose running share of the window's volume exceeds 10% — a daily volume profile; fixed once the window closes and absent until then; absent where the window has no range or no volume or no bin exceeds the threshold, and for a window that closed before these levels were first stored

supplyDemandThreshold.description: The volume threshold: the share of the window’s volume, counted in bins from its high (supply) or low (demand), a zone must exceed to end.

supplyDemandResolution.description: The resolution: the equal bins the window’s range is cut into. Off its default the server rebuilds the window from its 1m bars, which reach only the last two UTC days.

label: Supply zone average (prior UTC day)

label: TPO point of control (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the current week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO point of control (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: High so far (week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
